assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and all three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough constraints derived from the repository source; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive geometry, areas, figures, and phasing must be recalculated when organizer-supplied official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Approved land-use controls, road redlines, height controls, ownership, utilities, heritage, fire-safety, and engineering constraints are not present in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints and connectors are conceptual reference schemes; they do not determine demolition, construction, or approval.

assumptions.statement: The submission does not infer existing building condition or resident/enterprise demand from non-public data.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish decisions and service demand must follow field survey, rights-holder consultation, and professional review.

assumptions.statement: International cases are used only to compare transferable mechanisms, not to claim direct equivalence with Haidian.
assumptions.impact: Each mechanism requires local legal, cultural, operating, and spatial adaptation before any pilot.
